requirements.name: 支付失败

requirements.prompt: computer error alert, one harsh short buzz followed by a dull denied tone
requirements.notes: 必杀技 密码 / password / 断网 / offline / 蓝屏

requirements.notes: 必杀技 学生 / student「下课铃响！」/ 老师 / teacher

requirements.prompt: microphone tap tap, short squeal of feedback, then a pompous throat clearing

requirements.prompt: several rubber ducks quacking one after another, squeaky and silly

requirements.prompt: angry goose honking and hissing aggressively, flapping wings, comedic

requirements.prompt: heavy metal padlock snapping shut, one solid mechanical clack
requirements.notes: 必杀技 锁 / 🔒「咔哒上锁」

requirements.prompt: small toy rocket ignition, a sharp whoosh roaring upward and fading away

requirements.notes: 必杀技 可乐「摇过的可乐」

requirements.prompt: cream pie splatting onto a face, wet squishy splat
